results.title: Sustainability - Givaudan
results.content: # Sustainability. ## At Givaudan, sustainability means protecting our planet, colleagues, customers and consumers, and safeguarding the future of our business. We know that we can only live up to our [Company purpose](/our-company/about-givaudan/our-purpose) of ‘creating happier, healthier lives with love for nature’ if sustainability becomes an integral part of our everyday work. As our business grows, we must continue to act as a force for good in the world, working closely with our customers to meet their needs for more sustainable solutions and products, against the backdrop of a growing demand from society. Our [ground-breaking innovations](/sustainability/creations/heritage-action) are bringing us closer to a [climate positive future](/sustainability/our-climate-positive-journey). To ensure that we continue to make progress and focus our efforts, we have set specific targets under each of our four sustainability pillars: [Creations](/sustainability/creations), [Nature](/sustainability/nature), [People](/sustainability/people) and [Communities](/sustainability/communities). > Willem Mutsaerts, Head of Global Procurement and Sustainability.
